params.name: steps

default.title: Your AI key, at a glance
default.say: This card tells you whether a key is connected and ready. Everything in {product} that uses AI runs on the key you connect here.

default.title: Get a key
default.say: No key yet? How to get a key walks you through creating one in Google AI Studio in about two minutes. A free key is enough to begin.

default.title: Add and test your key
default.say: Press Add my key, paste it, give it a label so you remember whose account it came from, and choose the model. Save and test checks it with Google straight away; Google is the only judge of a key.

default.title: Test at any time
default.say: Test it re-checks the connected key whenever you like: useful after a billing change, or when a job refuses to start.

default.title: Set a budget
default.say: Choose the currency you think in, enter what you have budgeted and press Save budget. The meters show Budgeted, Spent here and Left, and every paid step checks this before it spends.

default.title: Your account
default.say: Your name, email and role, with Change password one click away.

default.title: More than one key
default.say: Keep several Gemini keys and move between them. Make default decides which works first; Test, Lend and Remove sit beside each key.

default.title: Other providers
default.say: Connect other providers and decide who does what: which model writes the text and which draws the stills. You choose; the portal never picks a paid model on your behalf.

default.title: Lend a key, safely
default.say: Press Lend on one of your keys to let a colleague use it without ever seeing it. Their spend is billed back to you, shows under Shared keys, and you can stop lending at any time.

default.title: Every paid run, accounted for
default.say: Key usage lists every paid run: which key, who ran it, what for, how long it took and what it cost. Search it by key, person or activity.
